answer_1.quote: Extractive document summarization is the task of creating a summary by identifying (and subsequently concatenating) the most important sentences in a document... We demonstrate this by learning intricate extractive content plan for the Rotowire table-to-text generation task. This task requires the generation of long summaries from large score tables...

answer_2.quote: We evaluated summarization quality using F1 Rouge... We report typical Rotowire metrics, using the standard information extraction system described by  to extract the box score table relations mentioned in the generated (G) and in the target (T) summary.

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation. Participants were shown two summaries of an NBA game and asked to compare them with respect to informativeness (Does a summary present a better selection of the relevant facts about the game?) and readability (Which summary has a better narrative flow and is easier to read?).
answer_4.guideline: Participants were shown two summaries of an NBA game and asked to compare them with respect to informativeness and readability.
